summary: In PIM Sparse Mode, a designated router sends periodic Null-Register messages to the rendezvous point to show that a multicast source is still active, one message per source and group. This document defines a way to put information about many sources and groups into a single packed PIM message, reducing message overhead.

eli5.summary: Instead of mailing one postcard per friend to say you're still here, you write one letter listing everyone. It uses fewer envelopes and less work.
